title: Video Editing & Creative Post-Production
description: Transforming rushes into compelling films with narrative pacing, dialogue clarity, balanced colour, and multi-format social exports.
seoDescription: Professional video editing, colour grading, and sound mixing for business, event, and brand films. Fast turnaround across Cambridge, London, and UK-wide.
heroHeading: Great footage is only the beginning. The story happens in the *edit.*
heroLead: Pacing, structure, and sound design turn raw footage into a compelling film. Whether working from rushes captured by our field crews or raw material supplied by your team, we assemble interviews, multi-camera angles, and cutaways into focused films with clean audio and balanced colour.
breakdownHeading: Where raw footage becomes *a finished film.*
breakdownBody: Editorial discipline means finding the core message and stripping away the noise. We refine dialogue, remove room reverberation, balance colour tones to match your brand palette, and add subtle motion graphics that give your content broadcast-level polish.

deliverables.title: Narrative Assembly & Editorial Pacing
deliverables.description: Careful assembly of primary dialogue, multicam angles, and purposeful B-roll cutaways, establishing a natural rhythm that holds viewer attention from the opening frame.

deliverables.title: Dialogue Cleanup, Sound Mix & Colour Grade
deliverables.description: Advanced audio restoration, background hum removal, licensed score mixing, and tone-matched colour grading across mixed camera sources to ensure high production value.

deliverables.title: Multi-Format Exports & Captioned Cutdowns
deliverables.description: Full-resolution master files alongside vertical 9:16 and square 1:1 social cutdowns with styled burned-in captions, ready for immediate publication across web and social feeds.

ctaHeading: Have raw footage you want to bring *to life?*
ctaDescription: Whether you're planning an upcoming shoot with our team or have raw rushes ready for editorial assembly, tell us about your project and timeline.
